MIT LibDriver MPU6500, a66ceb7a5f18473f4807daebf0c63afdc077cc4f. Original: https://github.com/libdriver/mpu6500 . RoboBachelor retains only raw register transport, init and AUX configuration functions. Header is unmodified; declarations for omitted APIs do not imply they are linked. No DMP code/header/blob is required or included. Retained function bodies are unchanged. Register defines moved to a separate header under the original MIT notice. Full upstream source hashes and retained function names: provenance.json.
